title: Answer: the metric of space self-generates from 1 by a Pythagorean cascade

statements.text: The metric of space bootstraps from the scalar unit through the chain $1^2 + (\sqrt{2})^2 = (\sqrt{3})^2$, $(\sqrt{2})^2 + (\sqrt{3})^2 = (\sqrt{5})^2$, which generates the field $K = \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{2}, \sqrt{3}, \sqrt{5})$. Space is a lattice with generators in $K$.

sources.quote: which we prove is strictly self-generating from the scalar unit via a coupled Pythagorean cascade
The metric of space bootstraps from a scalar unit via a strict Pythagorean cascade
